scientific_integrity: A closed four-variable sentence proves the upper bound. The lower bound uses the previously recorded Fano and block-complement equivalence, with a direct proof of the witness comparison. Finite diagnostics are corroborative only; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty simple undirected graphs, pure adjacency and equality, counting-free first-order logic. Exact variable width for class membership, not an optimal quantifier-rank claim or a new symmetric-design equivalence theorem.
